Hi David / Markus,

Following up with more concrete technical details and answers to Medicore's questions. I attached a spreadsheet with SCCs mapping and our responses (medicore-sccs-answers-v1.xlsx). Major points below — please let me know if you'd like any of these captured in a short Statement of Facts for legal.

1) EU-only processing
- We support EU-only tenants: all compute, object storage (S3-equivalent), and ephemeral cache (KV store) can be provisioned in the EU region (examples: eu-west-1, europe-west3).
- Control plane: for Private deployments we provide a customer-controlled control plane; for Hosted, metadata needed for provisioning is processed in our control plane (we can offer a customer-hosted control plane for enterprise customers on request).

2) SCCs and Schrems II implications
- SCCs: we are prepared to sign the standard EU Commission SCCs as controller-processor appendices for Hosted and Dedicated plans.
- Supplementary measures: we recommend (and can support) encryption-at-rest with customer-managed keys (BYOK via KMS/HSM), strict egress restriction at network edge, and minimized telemetry sent to non-EU endpoints.

3) Backups and deletion propagation
- Backup schedule: incremental backups every 12 hours, full snapshot weekly (default). Retention: default 30 days; configurable to a minimum of 7 days for this engagement.
- Deletion propagation: deletion requests delete the primary object and schedule background purge jobs that also remove entries from snapshots and backup indexes within a recovery window. For legal holds we can pause purge jobs until release.

4) Evidence for auditors
- We can provide: (a) a deletion receipt with timestamp and operation id, (b) filtered audit log entries showing the delete and the subsequent backup purge job completion, (c) SHA256 checksum of deleted object keys for cross-verification.
- Logs are retained for 180 days by default; we can export a filtered log bundle for the auditor.

5) Edge cases / notes
- If Medicore requires absolute cryptographic separation (no provider access to plaintext), we recommend a Private deployment with BYOK and no control-plane telemetry outside EU.
- For Dedicated customers with contractual commitments we can include SLA language around deletion timelines and proof delivery.

Next: I've attached the SCCs Q&A spreadsheet. Markus / Jonas — please review the contract language recommendations in tab "LegalNotes" and confirm whether we should propose additional supplementary measures.

Cheers,
Mina Haddad

David / Markus,

Thanks Mina — useful detail. From a contractual perspective I recommend the following items be included in the Processor Addendum / SCCs annex:

- Data location commitment: "All Processing of Customer Personal Data shall occur within the EU/EEA. Redwood shall not transfer Customer Personal Data outside the EU/EEA unless required by law or Customer instruction."
- Backup retention: express maximum backup retention (e.g., 30 days), with option for Customer to choose a shorter retention period at time of contract signature.
- Deletion proof: Redwood shall provide, within X business days of request, (i) deletion receipt, (ii) related audit log extracts, and (iii) confirmation that associated backups/snapshots have been purged.
- BYOK clause: option to enforce customer-managed encryption keys; include allowed KMS providers and key rotation responsibilities.

I can draft the exact SCCs annex language and attach as a DocuSign envelope if Medicore prefers. For transparency, we'll call out the operational steps that produce the deletion artifact ( API call -> purge job id -> backup index update -> log export ) so auditors can trace the chain.

Markus — want me to produce the draft addendum by Thursday (18 Jun)?

Best,

David,

Appended is a concise "Data Exit & Deletion Playbook" (see attached architecture + Q&A). TL;DR on the playbook:
- Pre-exit: freeze ingestion, create export snapshot, deliver encrypted export bundle to Medicore via secure transfer (SFTP or pre-signed EU-only object URL).
- Deletion: process deletion request -> mark objects for immediate deletion -> run backup purge job -> confirm purge job completion -> generate deletion receipt + audit log bundle.
- Verification: provide checksums and job ids; support a test deletion on a non-production subset to validate process prior to go-live.

We can commit to the following timeline for the SCCs + playbook deliverable:
- Thu 18 Jun: Jonas to share draft SCCs annex (in review) — DONE (draft in progress).
- Fri 19 Jun: Mina to confirm backup retention minimum and provide example deletion receipt format — DONE (attached).
- Mon 22 Jun: Provide final playbook + DocuSign envelope for SCCs annex.
- By Fri 26 Jun: Target countersignature (Medicore).
